newsitem.title: GREECE: DELTA SECURITIES OFFICIALS CHARGED WITH FRAUD.
newsitem.headline: DELTA SECURITIES OFFICIALS CHARGED WITH FRAUD.

text.p: A Greek public prosecutor charged three senior officials of Athens stock exchange member Delta Securities with fraud and banned them from leaving the country, court sources told Reuters.
Delta Securities was barred from trading on Thursday after failing to settle with the bourse's clearing house, sending a shock wave through the market. Brokers boycotted trading on Friday.
Delta Securities president Dimitris Argyriadis, vice-president Ioanna Gelestathi and board member Theofanis Gravanis were charged with large-scale, repeated fraud, the court sources said.
The case was assigned to an Athens investigating magistrate who will now hear testimony. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
